with order_items as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_order_items"

),

orders as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_orders"

),

products as (

    select * from "ecommerce"."STAGE"."stg_products"

),

joins as (

    select
        order_items.*,
        orders.customer_id,
        orders.store_id,
        orders.order_date,
        orders.order_status,
        products.cost_price

    from order_items
    left join orders on order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
    left join products on order_items.product_id = products.product_id

),

facts as (

    select
        *,
        quantity * price                                     as gross_amount,
        quantity * price * discount / 100                 as discount_amount,
        quantity * price * (1 - discount / 100)            as net_amount,
        quantity * cost_price                                      as total_cost,
        (quantity * price * (1 - discount / 100))
            - (quantity * cost_price)                               as margin

    from joins

)

select * from facts
